div.ab: LXXXVII. Ðonne man beam on wuda forbærne, ⁊ wurðe yppe on þone þe hit dyde, gilde he fulwite: ⁊ gesylle LX scll'; forðonðe fyr bið þeof.
LXXXVII. Ðonne mon beam on wuda forbærne, ⁊ weorðe yppe on þone ðe hit dyde, gielde he fulwite: geselle LX scill.; forþamþe fýr bið þeof.
Si quis in nemore trabem combusserit, et notum denique fuerit in actore, soluat plenam witam et emendet LX sol., quia ignis est fur.
{LXXXVII} Ðonne mon beam on wuda forbærne, ⁊ weorðe yppe on þone ðe hit dyde, gielde he fulwite: geselle LX sciƚƚ, forþamþe fyr bið þeof.
When someone burns a tree in the forest, and it becomes known who did it, let him pay a full fine; let him pay 60 shillings because “fire is a thief.”
If anyone destroys a tree in a wood by fire, and it becomes known who did it, he shall pay a full fine. He shall pay 60 shillings, because fire is a thief.
If anyone burns down a tree in the wood, and it is disclosed who did it, he is to pay full fine; he is to pay 60 shillings, for fire is a thief.
Wenn jemand einen Baum im Walde verbrennt, und es wird [dem Richter] kund über den, der es gethan hat, so zahle dieser volles Strafgeld: er gebe 60 Schill.; weil Feuer ein Dieb ist.
If someone burns a tree in the wood, and it becomes known [to the judge] who did it, let him pay the full fine: let him give 60 shillings; because fire is a thief.
